sse-route.reason: Interactive, not background work: the chapter Autofill modal streams to the person watching it (the plan's question 5). Stays.

A live Recording Session, not background work: the CVM recorder's events for the editor open on that Video. Its listening keeps the recorder open for that Video (the Cam Link and the previews); the recorder service records and the app server's recorder client saves whether or not anyone listens, so closing it cancels no recording.

Live, not background work: the AV Calibration page's level meter (#2078). Listening is what runs the recorder service's mic-only ffmpeg.exe, and the last listener going stops it, so it must end with the tab, the opposite of a Job. Stays.

Live, not background work: the Storage page's scan (#2107, spec #2103 decision 6). It is read-only, counted fresh for the person watching the page, and must stop when the tab goes (a scan must never keep reading a slow USB drive in the background): the opposite of a Job. Moves are Jobs; this is not.

Live, not background work: the per-bucket page's listing (#2108), the Storage page's read-only walk kept to one Storage Bucket. It is for the person watching the page and must stop when the tab goes, like the scan: the opposite of a Job.

A live stream, not background work: the Streaming tab hears the picked Broadcast's live chat as it's posted (#2453). It only listens: the app server reads the chat from the pick to End Stream whether or not anyone listens, so closing it cancels nothing.
